title: Dotnet Sdk not updating when exporting
key_points: The dotnet nuget builds update the Godot engine build correctly when building from source.
However, when exporting, the updated dotnet builds do not seem to be used.
To get the export to take the new dotnet builds, the dotnet build outputs in the mono module need to be deleted.
A bash script has been created to delete all folders ignored by git in a specified folder.
limitations: The script removes all files and folders that are being ignored due to .gitignore.
This could potentially remove important files if they are named similarly to the ignored ones.
The script relies on correct formatting of git status --ignored output.
asserts: When exporting a Godot project from source, the dotnet build outputs in the mono module need to be manually deleted to ensure the export uses the updated builds.
scope: The process of ensuring updated dotnet builds are used when exporting a Godot mono project from source.
